Getting started with Tokio

Tokio is an asynchronous runtime for the Rust programming language. It provides the building blocks needed for writing network applications, including a multi-threaded scheduler, a reactor and timers.

Installation

Add the dependency to your manifest and read the installation guide or the external notes. A bad link stays plain text.
